title: Review and reveal an OTA's payout account
caption: Connections tab of /tenants/[tenantId] (payout-account.tsx).

steps.title: Open the payout account
steps.expect: Masked fields only ('IBAN ending in 7947'), review status and note; 'not entered yet' when the owner has none.

steps.title: Verify or reject
steps.expect: Status follows; owner e-mailed; a stale version (owner changed it meanwhile) asks for a full reload.

steps.title: Reveal
steps.body: **Reveal bank details** → reason → code if asked.
steps.expect: IBAN in groups of four and BIC (or account and routing numbers) for 60 s with a countdown; **Hide now** clears it; no copy button; audit `payout_account.revealed` every time.
